subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Identificar a(s) informação(ões)-chave de partes de um texto em língua inglesa (parágrafos).

components.description_pt: Determinar a ideia principal de um texto informativo
components.description_en: Determine the main idea of an informational text
components.cc_component_description: Determine the main idea of an informational text

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre ideias centrais e detalhes de suporte em um texto
components.description_en: Distinguish between a text's central ideas and supporting details
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between a text's central ideas and supporting details

components.description_pt: Resumir o ponto central de parágrafos individuais em textos em língua inglesa
components.description_en: Summarize the central point of individual paragraphs in English-language texts
components.cc_component_description: Identify and summarize the main idea and key details of an informational text

components.description_pt: Localizar informações-chave específicas em um parágrafo designado de texto em inglês
components.description_en: Locate specific key information within a designated paragraph of an English text
components.cc_component_description: Locate specific key details in a text to support answers to comprehension questions

cc_matches.description: Determine the main idea of a text and explain how it is supported by key details; summarize the text.
Determine the central ideas or conclusions of a text; provide an accurate summary of the text distinct from prior knowledge or opinions.

Multilingual learners will interpret informational texts in language arts by
* Identifying and __summarizing__ main ideas and key details
* __Analyzing details and examples for key attributes, qualities, and characteristics__
* __Evaluating the impact of key word choices in a text__
Ask and answer such questions as who, what, where, when, why, and how to demonstrate understanding of key details in a text.
